main.description: Propose transferring ownership of a group to another member. Owner-only. The proposed new owner must already be a member; ownership does not move until they accept (app.certified.group.ownershipTransfer.accept), which proves they still control their DID. A group has at most one pending transfer at a time — a new proposal replaces any existing one. The proposal lapses if not accepted before it expires.

repo.description: The handle or DID of the target group. Omit when supplied via the querystring.

newOwner.description: The handle or DID of the member proposed as the new owner. Must already be a member.

expiresAt.description: When the proposal lapses if not accepted.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: newOwner is a malformed DID or an unresolvable handle.

errors.name: UnknownGroup
errors.description: The repo does not resolve to a managed group.

errors.name: NotAMember
errors.description: The proposed new owner is not a member of the group.

errors.name: AlreadyOwner
errors.description: The proposed new owner is already the group's owner.
